subject: POC kickoff & capacity calibration — scheduling + hosted vs dedicated decision
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aurorafinance.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@aurorafinance.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — availability + capacity questions

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Aurora is ready to spin up a 3‑week POC and we want to lock the kickoff and the hands‑on workshop where we run prompt review, routing tests and a short load run. A few items we need to finalize before the kickoff: 

- Hosted vs Dedicated: our infra team prefers dedicated for the load tests but procurement needs cost guidance and a short list of minimum GPU capacity.
- Token budget: rough estimate for the first two weeks is ~2M tokens for model evaluation and load validation — can that be accommodated?
- Rate limits/quota bump: If we do a short load test (simulated 200 concurrent sessions), what quota/limit changes are required on Redwood?
- Dates: We’re aiming for the week of July 24. Best times are mornings PST.

Can you propose a kickoff + 2‑hour hands‑on window and a follow up capacity planning call with your engineering lead?

Cheers,
Samir
Samir Patel
VP, Platform Engineering — Aurora Finance
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurorafinance.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability + capacity questions

Hi Samir — great to hear you’re ready to kick off. 

We can do the hands‑on workshop and the capacity planning call the week of July 24. Proposed schedule:

- Tue, Jul 25, 9:00–11:00 PST — POC kickoff + hands‑on (prompt review, routing test, short load run)
- Thu, Jul 27, 10:00–10:45 PST — capacity planning (Dedicated vs Hosted, token budgets, quota bump process)

I’m attaching a draft capacity plan and a token‑budget spreadsheet for you to review (redwood_capacity_plan_v1.pdf, aurora_token_budget_v2.xlsx). A few quick notes:

- For a 200 concurrent session load test we recommend a Dedicated pool (2×A800 equiv) for the 2‑hour window; Hosted can work for lower‑intensity evaluation but you’ll see higher variance in latency.
- We can provision a temporary quota bump for the load window; Ben can confirm the approval process.
- Please share the prompt set you want us to exercise and any sample traffic patterns.

Assigning Lauren to handle pre‑work and Lauren will send a short checklist for the prompt review.

If those times work I’ll send calendar invites and loop procurement.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@aurorafinance.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability + capacity questions

On Sun, Jul 22, 2028 at 09:18 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I’m attaching a draft capacity plan and a token‑budget spreadsheet for you to review 

Hi all — quick technical addendum from the runbook side: 

- Routing: we should decide routing policy ahead of time (latency‑first vs cost‑first). For the load run choose latency‑first; we’ll pin a high‑throughput model (quantized) and use continuous batching disabled to keep latency stable.
- KV/caching: bring a small prefix set for prompt review to get representative cache hit behavior — that will materially reduce token cost during the hands‑on.
- Load test profile: 20m ramp, 30m steady, 10m cool‑down; emulate 200 concurrent sessions with uniform prompt lengths (avg 120 tokens) and a 2–3 token/sec generation pacing.

I’ll prepare the recommended model config and an infra checklist. We can also provide a short script to simulate the traffic so you don’t need to spin up a separate load generator.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@aurorafinance.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@aurorafinance.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability + capacity questions

Samir / Monica — sounds good. Ben here — I approve a temporary quota bump to support the proposed load run for the POC (up to the token budget in aurora_token_budget_v2.xlsx). A couple process notes: 

- We’ll provision the Dedicated pool for the 2‑hour window on Jul 25 only; any extended Dedicated usage will require a short SOW/commit.
- Procurement: procurement@aurorafinance, please review the SOW link (DocuSign) and flag any contract items that need redlines.
- Post‑run telemetry: we’ll provide token cost and latency breakdown by route within 24 hours.

Approved — Monica, please send invites and include the runbook Sergio referenced.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurorafinance.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procure@aurorafinance.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated: POC kickoff + hands‑on (reschedule notice)

Hi Samir — small scheduling change: one of our infra leads has an unavoidable conflict on the 9:00 start. Can we shift the hands‑on 30 minutes later? New time: Tue, Jul 25, 9:30–11:30 PST. 

I’ve updated the calendar invite (link below) and attached the final runbook and capacity plan. Items for you before the session: 

- Share the prompt set in the shared doc by EOD Monday so Sergio can pre‑seed caches.
- Confirm traffic profile if you want any deviation from the run profile Sergio outlined.
- Procurement: please acknowledge the DocuSign SOW so we can provision Dedicated for the window.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=POC-kickoff-aurora
Runbook: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A-capacity-plan
Attachments: redwood_capacity_plan_v1.pdf, aurora_token_budget_v2.xlsx

See you Tuesday — thanks for being flexible.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
